title: Grilled Tunisian Smoked Chicken
description: A flavorful and spicy grilled chicken dish with smoky undertones, inspired by Tunisian cuisine. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, harissa, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the chicken breasts.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, brush the grill with some oil to prevent sticking.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they develop some char.
Serve the grilled chicken with the roasted tomatoes on top.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
